profiles.name: Friendly Name
profiles.validationError: Name, Vault address and SSH signer role are required

dialog.title: Vault sign-in required
dialog.description: A window has opened to sign in to HashiCorp Vault. Complete the sign-in there; this connection will continue automatically.
dialog.failed: Vault authentication failed. Please try again.

use.title: Use Vault SSH signing
use.description: Create Vault signer profiles and connect to hosts that use Vault.

share.title: Share Vault profiles
share.description: Mark a Vault signer profile as shared so every user can pick it.

redirectUri.label: Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Add this URL to allowed_redirect_uris in each Vault OIDC role that Termix signs in with.

legacyCallback.label: Use the old redirect URI
legacyCallback.description: Keep sending /vault/oidc/callback, the redirect URI used before 2.9. Turn this off once your Vault roles allow the new one.
